name: Human perspective maps (Polislike human cartography prototype v2)

mentions.name: Human perspective maps (Polislike human cartography prototype v2)
mentions.description: An interactive prototype that generates 'human perspective maps' by applying non-linear dimensional reduction algorithms to hundreds of agree/disagree/pass statements, visualizing the 'human value manifold' like Google Maps for complex large-scale conversations. Users paint groups with colors and click a painted group to see what differentiates the painted groups. It builds on the philosophy of democracy-bolstering conversation tools like Pol.is.
